title: PROBING THE TRAJECTORIES OF REASONING TRACES IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether specific generated formatting tokens (such as LaTeX \boxed{} tags) artificially skew the model's next-token probabilities toward predicting a specific multiple-choice answer (e.g., option 'A'), overriding actual reasoning.

Calculating the 'anchoring rate', which measures the probability that a stronger target model repeats a weaker initial model's incorrect answer when injected with the weaker model's partial reasoning trace.
